title: Nordic-RSE operation manuals
description: Nordic-RSE's internal handbook: manuals, checklists, and templates for running the association, its board, its conferences, and its website.
notes: The structure of this handbook was informed by the CSCCE (Center for Scientific Collaboration and Community Engagement, https://www.cscce.org/) Creating Community Playbooks workshop. Suggested citation: Pratt, Katie and Woodley, Lou. (2025). CSCCE course info sheet: Creating Community Playbooks (PBK). Center for Scientific Collaboration and Community Engagement. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15793475
